status.values_note: Observed values across this dataset's 390 nights (2026-06-28 scan): balanced=326, unbalanced=51, low=12, none=1. Classifies the 7-day rolling average against the personal baseline range; for this user it is monotonically low-side (balanced > unbalanced > low), and 'high' never occurs. The SDK profile may define additional values (e.g. 'high'); the normalizer handles them but they are absent here.
status.description: HRV status classification of the 7-day average vs the personal baseline range
